arguments.script: var root=UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents("Assets/Tiles/UnifiedTerrain/Forest Palette.prefab");try{root.name="Rock Palette";var tile=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.RuleTile>("Assets/Tiles/RockTerrain/Rock.asset");foreach(var m in root.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>()){m.ClearAllTiles();m.SetTile(UnityEngine.Vector3Int.zero,tile);}UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root,"Assets/Tiles/RockTerrain/Rock Palette.prefab");}finally{UnityEditor.PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(root);}var target="Assets/Tiles/RockTerrain/Rock Palette.prefab";var settings=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath("Assets/Tiles/UnifiedTerrain/Forest Palette.prefab").FirstOrDefault(a=>a is UnityEditor.Tilemaps.GridPalette);if(settings)UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AddObjectToAsset(UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(settings),target);UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
